# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 050

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1225–1249, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. I simplified the weekday, home, furniture, and household-object definitions for learners, removing unnecessary religious or technical detail while preserving the taught meanings. The Hindi entries were semantically aligned with their examples.

Changed: 25 English definitions. Refreshed source fingerprints for these 25 senses in the locale status files.  
Progress: 1,250/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (14.14%); 7,587 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
